summary: Extinguish the fire. An alcohol-free, cooling emulsion that immediately neutralizes razor burn and rebuilds the disrupted epidermal barrier.
description: Dermal triage for freshly shaved skin. Passing a blade over the skin removes the top layer of the stratum corneum. This balm utilizes witch hazel and aloe to instantly halt inflammation and prevent micro-bacterial infection.
technical_overview: Offered at $24.0 for 100ml, this KoColor AFTERSHAVE is expertly formulated with Witch Hazel, Aloe Vera Leaf Juice, and Allantoin. It delivers a high-fidelity Cooling Aqua color profile (`#E0FFFF`) and leverages anti-inflammatory vasoconstriction.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Massage a dime-sized amount into freshly shaved areas immediately after patting dry.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Avoid colognes or perfumes on the neck area for 20 minutes after application to prevent severe chemical irritation of the exposed follicles.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Formulated strictly without SD Alcohol to prevent the classic "stinging" sensation, which is biologically indicative of cellular damage, not sanitation.
